page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.8xlarge is a big data and storage-focused virtual instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is provisioned with 128.0 GB of system memory, matching a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps, with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included.

A defining characteristic of the ecs.d1.8xlarge is its bundled local high-capacity storage, delivering 94,489 GB of local hard disk drives (HDD). The architecture omits hardware accelerators, carrying zero dedicated GPUs. Instead, the resource profile prioritizes dense physical magnetic media directly attached to the host, facilitating extremely high storage capacity at a lower cost per gigabyte relative to solid-state alternatives.

Because it utilizes mechanical HDDs rather than flash NVMe storage, random I/O latency is elevated, trading peak IOPS for dense, cost-efficient sequential throughput and massive local retention. The instance is designed for distributed computing platforms and bulk storage applications, including Apache Hadoop MapReduce clusters, Apache Spark processing, Apache Kafka event ingestion, centralized log processing, and cold or warm data archiving.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.8xlarge is a big data compute instance featuring 32 dedicated vCPUs driven by 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors on x86_64 architecture. Equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, the system maintains a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core alongside a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The system includes 94,489 GB of local HDD storage without dedicated GPU hardware. Designed around bulk storage capacity and sequential data processing, the mechanical disk array offers significant storage density and qualitative cost efficiency for high-volume data retention over flash media. While random access speeds are limited by mechanical HDD properties, the instance offers balanced processing and network throughput for data-intensive architectures. The configuration is appropriate for Apache Hadoop clusters, distributed data lakes, large-scale log analysis, batch ETL jobs, and long-term analytical storage pipelines.
